scientific_integrity: Analytic Poisson splitting and Campbell identity; deterministic-seed continuum Monte Carlo is a reproducibility check, not infinite-domain certification. Literature originality is limited to compared sources and searchable research records.
scientific_limitations: Initially vacant infinite homogeneous one-dimensional substrate; independent spatial Poisson head attempts; bounded strictly positive connected intervals; head-only acceptance; finite-time gap-count intensity, not independent gaps. Overall undamaged fraction and higher correlations are not determined.
title: Exponential empty-gap universality under polydisperse head-only adsorption
